title: Research: four signed-connector transfers force unit coefficients
body:
The signed 3×3 connector's port theorem in #1682 excludes nonunit transfers. This contribution proves that its **entire enlarged coefficient alphabet collapses to the unit class**: with exactly twelve ordinary signed child queries and four nonzero one-way root transfers over Q or C, every transfer coefficient must be +1 or −1. The six operator ports and complete fixed additive tariff are therefore unchanged.

**Status: scoped theorem / research note; no new κ.** The proof retains arbitrary independent dirty roots, immutable sources, unread outputs, and uniform correctness for arbitrary linear Ai/Bj. Equal-height readouts force one transfer pair to be unit; restoration of the same source coefficient forces the other pair. The included proof independently establishes the port reduction and then forces all four coefficients to be units.

Only `research/nonunit-signed-connector-rigidity/` is added. Reproduce:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/nonunit-signed-connector-rigidity/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_NONUNIT_SIGNED_CONNECTOR_RIGIDITY`.

A six-vertex/two-leaf cube argument supplies a direct written proof of the inherited one-root obstruction, with finite checks as corroboration. Verification includes generic exact elimination versus a separate difference formula on all 192 coefficient systems; event permutations versus cube-state dynamic programming on the inherited 720-walk obstruction; free noncommutative forward/inverse maps; and separate dense block-matrix checks on all 16 dirty basis columns. All 48 consistent coefficient systems have unit solutions. Seventeen semantic program mutations fail. Valid scaled-query and six-transfer controls show that the named restrictions matter. Read-only relocation and two actual source-corruption controls pass.

Primary checks pass on stable CPython 3.15.0 through the research wrapper. The repository's explicitly pinned Python 3.12 registered replay also passes on 3.12.12. Metadata/source pins, selected-record verification, five selected-record tests, binding-only baseline and diff checks pass. Hosted CI is separate. The written program-to-equation reduction is not proof-assistant or independently human-reviewed evidence; the distinct models were written by the same assistant.

Credit Ross Richardson's #944 target/one-root obstruction, #1651 attaining word and #1682 unit-port argument; Charles Bethin's #1637 dirty two-root interface; Cinna Davis's #1675 distinct bidirectional short-transfer obstruction; and the predecessor notices retained in NOTICE.md. Exact heads and source hashes are supplied. The 7,257,600-trace unit census is **not repeated or claimed as a new result**. This closes its excluded coefficient freedom rather than adding a small tested coefficient neighborhood.

No selected-supplier seam, physical admission, new recursive schedule, full cold replay, selected-frontier change or new multiplication exponent is claimed. Complete child/source/frame/restoration/transfer/control costs remain in the conditional tariff. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed. Apache-2.0.
